name: Štanjel
text: Štanjel (pronounced [ˈʃtaːnjɛu̯]; Italian: San Daniele del Carso) is a village in the Municipality of Komen in the Littoral region of Slovenia. It is located on the Karst Plateau overlooking the Vipava Valley. In the 17th century it was fortified to defend it against Ottoman raids.

depictions.name: Stanjel
depictions.text: uo Stanjel is a multiplayer map featured in Call of Duty: United Offensive. The factions for this map are the Soviets against the Germans.
